description: Passes the person's feedback, approval or direction to their existing Freebeat video session, as the chat box on freebeat.ai does, and can change the session's auto setting. A message is accepted only while the director agent is not running. Work the agent does after a message uses the user's Freebeat credits. The agent's reply appears in get_video_session.

auto_mode.description: Optional change of the session's auto setting, applied before sending the message. Omit to keep its current setting.

message.description: The person's feedback, approval or direction for the video, in their own words.

task_id.description: The task_id from generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video.

name: send_video_agent_message

outputSchema.description: On success, returns the tool result fields. On error, returns success:false, error and code, with optional credit approval details; success-only fields are absent.

auto_mode.description: Auto setting confirmed by PATCH when requested; get_video_session returns the current effective setting.

task_id.description: The task_id from generate_music_video, generate_dance_video, or generate_lyric_video.
